topics.title: Tencent publishes ORIDTP AI platform for dual-target therapeutic peptides in Nature
topics.summary: Tencent's AI for Life Sciences Lab published ORIDTP in Nature on November 25, 2026, an open-source reinforcement learning platform for designing dual-target therapeutic peptides. In preclinical mouse studies, its lead candidates improved obesity markers at one-tenth the molar dose of semaglutide and cut tumor volume by 94.2% in zero-shot checkpoint tests.

topics.title: Bank of England flags opaque AI financing and open-weight model cyber risks
topics.summary: In its November 26, 2026 Financial Stability Report, the Bank of England's Financial Policy Committee warned that opaque, debt-fueled AI infrastructure financing and stretched tech valuations could transmit shocks across credit markets. It also cautioned that cheaper open-weight frontier models with easily stripped guardrails lower barriers for cyberattacks against financial institutions.

topics.title: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work modes with shared usage limits
topics.summary: OpenAI began rolling out a unified ChatGPT interface merging its Chat and Work modes into a single experience with a shared usage meter for advanced models. While OpenAI says the change streamlines workflows and leaves its Instant model unlimited, heavy subscribers raised concerns about hitting rate limits sooner ahead of a December expansion.
